rules: No URL credentials, API key fallback, Origin, duplicate security headers or body-selected authority.
All proofs match installation, full subject, persistent host and boot instance at server-issued generation.
Registration receipt contains no sessionToken or replacement credential.
Existing per-operation adapter declarations remain required and are activated only after successful registration receipt delivery.
Missing/false durableStateHealthy or unavailable actual adapter means not execution-ready; heartbeat alone is insufficient.
readyCommandTypes contains only existing command types supported by actual adapters; duplicate or unknown types reject registration. An empty/missing list does not admit commands.
profiles.EXECUTE in existing chat runtimeCapabilities v1 remains unavailable; do not change this chat contract to advertise command execution.
Authenticated presence can report durableStateHealthy false and immediately retire execution readiness without denying already-executed outcome reports.
ACK body proof must equal authenticated session proof, not select authority.

deliveryVersion is nullable last confirmed D06 version, never a predicted first CAS version. Only matching status and a valid monotonic D06 result version with ADVANCED/PRIOR confirms the command commit; persist that exact result in the existing checkpoint.
Expired commands deny new RECEIVED/STARTED admission, not terminal reports of already executed work.
Transport failure preserves the existing checkpoint and original message/command/work keys.

limits: tokenHash rotates at registration but carries no installation/host/instance/generation ownership.
Installation version is heartbeat CAS, not an execution-session fence.
Process-local socket map is readiness evidence only, never durable ownership.
recovery: Add nullable columns only; no backfill or business-key rewrites.
Null ownership is execution-not-ready until an installation-authorized claim commits.
Same installation/host may rotate generation on reconnect/reboot; another host/installation is rejected, not silently displaced.
Schema removal is not needed to recover: preserve additive columns; never restore stale credentials or replay work.
persistentFenceEvidence.authorization: Schema/mapper coordination pending; no production DDL authorized.
